title: Source-bound gaps between legacy SWBOTB=1 state machine and current explicit Reference-Richards seam

confirmed_gaps.finding: reference_richards_legacy_solve rejects bottom_mode=1 in validate_legacy_request before HeadCalc
confirmed_gaps.consequence: No typed mode-1 trial is reachable through the admitted soil-water solver ABI.

confirmed_gaps.finding: The mode-1 branch increments NN while grid_z(NN+1)>gwlinp and subsequently evaluates grid_z(NN+1). The explicit parameter contract allocates z with exactly active_nodes entries; grid_z uses parameter_set%z(node) without an explicit n+1 lower sentinel.
confirmed_gaps.consequence: The legacy below-profile branch cannot be claimed safe/source-equivalent on the current explicit geometry contract. A typed route must derive the below-profile test from declared bottom-face geometry without relying on an implicit legacy z(n+1) convention.

confirmed_gaps.finding: Mode-1 special branches call legacy watcon/hconduc/cofgen directly: above-top initialization uses watcon/hconduc and inside-profile saturated continuation assigns theta=cofgen(2,i), even when an explicit constitutive provider is active.
confirmed_gaps.consequence: A mode-1 explicit trial would mix provider-owned hydraulics with legacy-global constitutive state. LOW01-B cannot be called a typed provider-owned route until saturated continuation and special-branch constitutive evaluation have one explicit owner.

confirmed_gaps.finding: initialize_reference_state_binding maps boundary.bottom_head to gwlinp, but soil_water_solve_result_t exposes candidate groundwater_level from state%gwl. The mode-1 special branch does not establish a typed result rule that candidate groundwater_level equals the prescribed gwlinp.
confirmed_gaps.consequence: The control coordinate and the returned shared phreatic state are not yet the same typed object.

confirmed_gaps.finding: reference_richards_legacy_solve has accepted-step qbot materialization for bottom_mode=5 and residual publication for mode=2, but no mode-1 typed post-solve materialization. Inside-profile HeadCalc diagnoses qbot internally; below-profile mode 1 follows the mode-5 residual branch but lacks an equivalent typed accepted-step qbot publication rule.
confirmed_gaps.consequence: HLINK04 cannot obtain a branch-independent authoritative qbot output from the current solver result contract.

what_is_already_reusable: soil_water_boundary_conditions_t already carries a scalar bottom_head field that can be superseded by a dedicated groundwater-level control rather than overloaded
reference_richards_state_binding_t already carries gwlinp, gwl, fllowgwl, hbot and complete hydraulic arrays
HeadCalc already contains the B1.11 mode-1 active-domain/Jacobian/state-machine physics
transactional immutable-origin semantics already exist in FMR and F-GC and can be reused once a typed trial exists
rationale: A test-only wrapper that simply calls HeadCalc with bottom_mode=1 would hide unresolved geometry, constitutive ownership and output-state semantics.
Passing such a harness would overstate typed readiness and would not be sufficient authority for HLINK04.
next: Define GC-LOW01 candidate typed contract with an explicit H_phreatic control coordinate, branch diagnostics and bottom-face geometry.
Preregister LOW01-A as below-profile equivalence using derived bottom-face distance rather than implicit z(n+1).
Preregister LOW01-B only after saturated continuation is provider-owned or source-equivalent through an independently qualified legacy constitutive binding.
Preregister LOW01-D rollback/replay only after the candidate trial object has complete branch and output state.
